votes.motion: Reconsider the action on August 16, 2022, closing the Budget Amendment #1 public hearing
votes.description: The Council reconsidered its August 16, 2022 action closing the public hearing on Budget Amendment No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2022-23, reopening the hearing so it could be continued.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing for Budget Amendment No. 1 to a future date
votes.description: The Council continued the reopened public hearing on Budget Amendment No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2022-23 to a future date (set for Tuesday, September 6, 2022).

The Council approved the consent agenda, setting a September 20, 2022 public hearing date for the resolution authorizing the lease rate and term, and for the ordinance rezoning, for The Other Side Village Pilot Project at 1850 West Indiana Avenue (Petition PLNPCM2021-00787).

The Council moved to exit the Closed Session. Recorded in the minutes ahead of the entering motion; the closed session was held via Webex and in the Work Session Room from 6:25 pm to 6:40 pm. Council Member Valdemoros was absent for this vote.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for the purposes of strategy sessions to discuss pending or reasonably imminent litigation and attorney-client matters
votes.description: The Council moved to enter into Closed Session under Utah Code Section 52-4-205 to discuss pending or reasonably imminent litigation and privileged attorney-client matters. Recorded in the minutes after the exit motion.
